findings.problem: There is no lemma stating how `sphereCone p (join (r, y))` evaluates. The goals at lines 16, 34 and 40 all contain this expression, and each one has to unfold the global definition `sphereCone` (`(z 0) • sphereParam p (dropPlane z)`) and then rewrite the projections with `join_zero` and `drop_join` to reach the intended normal form `r • sphereParam p y`. Line 34 uses an unrestricted `simp [sphereCone]`, which exposes the raw definition to the whole default simp set. Line 40 also unfolds `sphereParam`. Because the definition is exposed instead of having a stable interface, every proof depends on the internal form of `sphereCone`.
findings.proposed_change:
Add a canonical evaluation lemma, either before `sphereCone_injOn` or next to `sphereCone` in SphereConeChart.lean:

@[simp] lemma sphereCone_join (p : Sphere) (r : ℝ) (y : E2) :
    sphereCone p (join (r, y)) = r • sphereParam p y := by
  simp [sphereCone]

Then replace `simp only [sphereCone,join_zero,drop_join] at he` with `simp only [sphereCone_join] at he`, and replace `simp [sphereCone]` on line 34 with `simp [sphereCone_join]` (or plain `simp` if the lemma is `@[simp]`). Optionally, also add `sphereParam_extChartAt (hq : q ∈ (extChartAt I2 p).source) : sphereParam p (extChartAt I2 p q) = q.val`. Line 40 could then be written as `simp only [sphereCone_join, sphereParam_extChartAt hqp]` without unfolding `sphereParam`.
findings.benefit: With the lemma, `sphereCone p (join (r, y))` always rewrites in one step to `r • sphereParam p y`, with no unfolding of definitions. The left-hand side `join (r, y)` is a constructor-style pattern that matches the actual goals and does not overlap with `join_zero` or `drop_join`, so it adds no competing rule or cycle. Proofs would no longer depend on how `sphereCone` is defined internally, and the unrestricted `simp [sphereCone]` call would go away.

evidence.excerpt: def sphereCone (p : Sphere) (z : E3) : E3 := (z 0) • sphereParam p (dropPlane z)
@[simp] lemma join_zero (z : ℝ × E2) : join z 0 = z.1 := rfl
@[simp] lemma drop_join (z : ℝ × E2) : dropPlane (join z) = z.2 := by ext i; rfl
